REGISTRATION OF TITLE ACT, No. 21 OF 1998
Declaration of Determination of the Commissioner of Title Settlement under Section 14

BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 14 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998, I, the undersigned, hereby de-clare my determination as set out in the Schedule appended hereto in regard to the title to parcel of Land No.159 of Block 01, contained in the Cadastral Map No. 620076, situated in the Village of Dorawela , within the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 256 B - Kirindigala in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Balangoda in the District of Rathnapura, in the Province of Sabaragamuwa, referred to in No-tice No. 62/0133 calling for claims to land parcels which was duly published in the Gazette No. 1658/14 of 15th May, 2010 in terms of Section 12 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998.
